thread:
Asha: Quick sync — follow-up from yesterday's postmortem. We're still seeing a repeating pattern: missing spans occurring after leader failover + partial ETL commits. Need concrete owners, timelines, and a backfill plan. @Ben @Carla can you take owners?
Ben: I can own ETL fix. Plan: add commit visibility, per-shard lag histograms, and abort on partial commits. ETA: patch in 7 days, canary deploy, full rollout target 2026-04-02. Will post PR and checklist here.
Carla: I'll own aggregator validation and streaming guards. Two tracks: (1) offline replay + correctness tests to detect overwrites/duplicates, (2) streaming job guard to reject partial windows. ETA: test harness in 2 business days, fix by end of week. Need infra for replay.
Asha: Lina to estimate backfill scope/cost and draft SLO impact & customer communication. Also define maintenance window for the backfill.
Lina: Estimate: ~60 node-hours for replay, ~2.5TB temp storage. Ballpark cost $1.4k. If we run incremental backfill (oldest-first) with throttling we can finish ~90h. Drafting runbook and proposed maintenance window (small risk to metrics, will notify affected customers).
Ben: Root cause summary: commit_marker propagation race during leader failover; aggregator sometimes processes partial shard data before commit visible to aggregation layer. Prototype patch: ```if (!commit_marker.exists()) { retry_or_abort(); }``` Will add pre-commit check + short leader-stabilization delay and a safety abort.
Carla: Adding monitoring: alert when span_coverage < 95% over 15m -> page oncall. New dashboard tile: "aggregator window success rate" with 1h historical and 6h trend.
ops-bot: Created Jira INFR-4512 "ETL partial commit guard" assigned to Ben, due 2026-04-02.
Asha: Action recap table (summary in thread): Ben — ETL guard (due 2026-04-02); Carla — aggregator tests + streaming guard (due 2026-03-30); Lina — backfill plan & cost (due 2026-03-28); Asha — coordinate maintenance window + customer note (due 2026-03-29). Daily standup checks until closed.
Ben: :thumbsup: Will post PR + canary checklist when ready.
Carla: :white_check_mark: Started test harness but need access to replay dataset — @infra-team can we get replay access?
Dmitri: Granted replay access to Carla for 7 days and provisioned 2 extra replay nodes. Created infra ticket INFRA-7623 for quota.
Lina: Uploaded draft backfill runbook to /docs/backfills/backfill-missing-spans.md and will link the maintenance window proposal shortly.
Asha: I'll update the postmortem doc with this action table and schedule a weekly Friday 11:00 status until actions are green. If anyone hits blockers, escalate here. :eyes:
